video_title: NBA Lottery Tennessee's Nate Ament - Versatile and Athletic

quotes.speaker: Nate Ament
quotes.summary_phrase: Nate Ament's draft expectations and projected landing spot
quotes.excerpt: Anywhere from four to 10. That's where me and my agency have been talking about where I'm projected.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
text_blocks.text: What are your expectations coming into the draft? Where do you expect to land?

text_blocks.speaker: Nate Ament
text_blocks.text: Anywhere from four to 10. That's where me and my agency have been talking about where I'm projected.

quotes.speaker: Nate Ament
quotes.summary_phrase: Nate Ament on showcasing his competitive nature in NBA workouts
quotes.excerpt: For me just showcasing my ability to compete. They're looking for a competitive group coming into the workout.
quotes.quote: Getting to these workouts, especially from rookies coming in, they're expecting people to come in and compete, play hard, play defense. For me just showcasing my ability to compete. They let you know before the workout they're looking for a competitive group coming into the workout. So I think me showing my ability to compete, my offensive versatility and also my mindset on defense to go out there and guard whoever.

quotes.speaker: Nate Ament
quotes.summary_phrase: Nate Ament's offensive versatility and role at the next level
quotes.excerpt: I just think you can plug me in anywhere on the offensive side of the ball.
quotes.quote: I just think you can plug me in anywhere on the offensive side of the ball. I can set screens, come off ball screens, offensive rebound. I can do virtually anything you need me to do on the offensive side of the floor.

quotes.speaker: Nate Ament
quotes.summary_phrase: Nate Ament on choosing Tennessee for defensive and physical development
quotes.excerpt: I knew I had to get better defensively. Tennessee is one of the best defensive teams.
quotes.quote: It was pretty simple. I knew I had to get better defensively. Tennessee is one of the best defensive teams in the country. I knew I had to get a lot stronger and they have the best strength coach in the country. And then also who Coach Barnes is, I knew who was going to push me and make me uncomfortable every single day and that's what he did.

quotes.speaker: Nate Ament
quotes.summary_phrase: Nate Ament on Coach Barnes' coaching style and intensity
quotes.excerpt: He's the nicest guy off the court, but while we're on the court, he was on me every day.
quotes.quote: He's the nicest guy off the court, but while we're on the court, he was on me every day, trying to push every button, making fun of me and just telling me what I'm not. Sometimes during practice he would say, 'You think you're a top five pick, you're absolutely wrong.' But he was just trying to push me, trying to get every ounce that he could out of me.

quotes.speaker: Nate Ament
quotes.summary_phrase: Nate Ament on handling the pressure of being a top prospect
quotes.excerpt: I've learned I really can't focus on what critics are saying or anyone saying who's the best.
quotes.quote: It was frustrating, especially as a basketball player, you think you're the best in the world and rightfully so. But I've learned I really can't focus on what critics are saying or anyone saying who's the best, who's not the best, what they think about me. I can just attack what I do, my daily habits and try to be the best player I can be, no matter what anyone's saying around me.

quotes.speaker: Nate Ament
quotes.summary_phrase: Nate Ament on the competitive nature of the SEC
quotes.excerpt: Every game in the SEC, a team could beat you.
quotes.quote: Every game in the SEC, a team could beat you. And then also just the developmental part of it. Like I talked about with Tennessee and how good they are defensively, that's something I need to improve on. And with our strength coach, he was going to push me to get better and you hear about the SEC being one of the most physical leagues in the country and I need to be more physical and kind of learn that side of the game.

quotes.speaker: Nate Ament
quotes.summary_phrase: Nate Ament on his defensive potential and physical development
quotes.excerpt: I think when you're blessed with the physical abilities, I think it would be a dishonor if I didn't try.
quotes.quote: I think that someone being blessed with the 6-10 frame, I think there's another level I can take it to. I think when you're blessed with the physical abilities, I think it would be a dishonor if I didn't try my best to become the best defender in the world.

quotes.speaker: Nate Ament
quotes.summary_phrase: Nate Ament on Victor Wembanyama's influence on defensive standards
quotes.excerpt: Hearing about him talking about how he was unanimous defensive player of the year, that's 50% of the game.
quotes.quote: Even hearing about him talking about how he was unanimous defensive player of the year, that's 50% of the game that plays a huge part of impacting winning. So hearing him speak about that was definitely kind of altered what I thought about defense a little bit.

quotes.speaker: Nate Ament
quotes.summary_phrase: Nate Ament on the business side of the NBA draft process
quotes.excerpt: Going through the interview process, you understand how much of a business it is.
quotes.quote: Going through the interview process, you understand how much of a business it is. They're making a multi-million dollar investment in a young kid and a lot of things can go wrong, a lot of things can go right, but they have to make sure everything is in order. But I think just them kind of understanding the type of person that they're bringing in, are they going to go crazy once they get this multi-million dollar contract or are they going to be smart and kind of understand what this team is asking of them?

quotes.speaker: Nate Ament
quotes.summary_phrase: Nate Ament on his personal accountability and focus
quotes.excerpt: I'm my own biggest critic. I do a good job of kind of policing myself.
quotes.quote: I'm my own biggest critic. I do a good job of kind of policing myself and understanding what I need to get better at, what I need to do. I honestly don't let social media and other people's opinion affect how I show up every day or what I need to change. I'm really the most focused on the locker room and the head coaches and what they're asking of me.

quotes.speaker: Nate Ament
quotes.summary_phrase: Nate Ament on what teams are getting in him
quotes.excerpt: A competitor, first and foremost. I think that's the most important thing.
quotes.quote: A competitor, first and foremost. I think that's the most important thing. Especially whether the team was a good team the previous year or not, I think for me, what would be the greatest achievement is stepping into a team and them being a playoff contender every year. I don't want to ever not being able to play in the postseason. I think that's the biggest thing for me. So a competitor, and we mentioned the offensive versatility, but also defensive versatility, and someone who's just willing to do whatever it takes to win.

quotes.speaker: Nate Ament
quotes.summary_phrase: Nate Ament on Tennessee's loss to Michigan in the NCAA tournament
quotes.excerpt: They beat the hell out of us, honestly. Credit to them, they're a really good team.
quotes.quote: They beat the hell out of us, honestly. Credit to them, they're a really good team. A lot of what we did last year was we were a really good offensive rebounding team, and Michigan is one of the best transition teams in the country. And with their size, it was hard to get offensive rebounds over them. And when they got the defensive rebound, they were off to the races and we only had our point guard back, so it was tough to kind of deal with that.
